$schemaComment: CENTRAL PRICING CONFIG — all commercial £ values for the public quote engine. UI components must not hard-code fares. See `pricingModel` for the formula.

pricingModel.summary: One engine for every eligible online journey: driving route (when available) → distance/time reference → distance-band adjustment → airport zone/minimum rules when an airport leg is present → vehicle supplement → optional return 5% discount → rounded fixed fare.
pricingModel.addressToAddress: OTS-style reference (vehicleBase + tier×(perKm×km + perMin×min)) + addressToAddressDistanceBands adjustment. Requires valid route metrics; otherwise no fare.
pricingModel.airport: Calibrated areaAirportSurchargesGbp zones supply short/medium airport fares (scales by origin zone, not a hard-coded town-pair). Estate uses tiered premium (≤£45 +£5; mid +£8; ≥£140 +£24; Dublin flat +£8). Airport-zone OTS calibration targets ~£3–£5 below OTS estate (airportOtsCalibration) without feeding live quotes. When route metrics exist: unknown origins use distance+airport minimum; long hauls (≥ airportRouteDistanceProtectFromKm) take max(zone, distance) for empty-return protection. BHD/BFS also apply belfastAirportDistanceFloor (MAX zone vs £65/£60 + £2/mile above 20 miles) so named zones do not flatten longer journeys. No weekend/Bank Holiday surcharge — weekday and weekend use the same base fare (airportTripPremiumRate / addressToAddressTripPremiumRate are 0).
pricingModel.dublinAirport: Belfast-centre DUB journey fare remains the zone benchmark (£230 saloon / £238 estate before fixed costs). After airportFixedCostsGbp: drop-off +£4 M1 (customer £234 saloon); pickup +£8 parking+M1 (customer £240 saloon after roundFare). Dublin city uses DUB fare + dublinCityBeyondAirport uplift.
pricingModel.vehicles: Saloon 1–4 pax AND 0–2 large cases; Estate 1–4 pax AND 3–4 cases; Minibus 5–7 pax (or >4 large cases for capacity). Online Minibus fare: estateTier×1.55 airport / £60 A2A base.
pricingModel.returnDiscount: returnJourneyDiscountRate (exactly 5%) applied once to (2 × oneWay journey fare). Airport fixed costs (fees / parking / M1 toll allowances) are added after and are never discounted.
pricingModel.airportFixedCosts: Per-leg: BFS/BHD £0 on address↔airport; DUB drop £4 / pick £8; LDY £0. A2A BFS↔BHD retains destination-end historical surcharge only (not £9).
pricingModel.rounding: Prefer nearest £5; amounts ending in £x4 are kept (e.g. £34, £49).

operational.description: Optional cost breakdown fields (empty return, time, tolls, airport charges). When weekday/weekend £ rates are filled, A2A quotes use this model; otherwise the OTS reference model is used.

airportAccessFeesGbp.note: DEPRECATED. Live address↔airport BFS/BHD fees are £0; A2A BFS↔BHD retains destination-end historical surcharge via shared/airport-fixed-costs getAirportToAirportFixedCostGbp.

airportFixedCostsGbp.note: BFS/BHD drop-off and pickup fees £0 on address↔airport. Dublin unchanged. A2A BFS↔BHD waives collection surcharge only (keep destination £5/£4) — see shared/airport-fixed-costs.ts.

airportEstatePremiumTiers.note: BFS/BHD/LDY estate uplift by rounded saloon fare: ≤£45 → +£5; £46–£139 → +£8; ≥£140 → +£24. Dublin Airport always uses airportEstatePremiumGbp (£8).

airportOtsCalibration.note: Calibration-only target vs live OTS estate for BFS/BHD/LDY zone surcharges. Does not feed the live customer quote formula. Midpoint ~£4 undercut.

belfastAirportDistanceFloor.note: BHD/BFS only: when OSRM miles (1dp) > 20, final saloon = max(zone/existing, floor). Floor uses raw miles. Floor-winning fares snap to nearest £5; zone-winning fares stay exact. Does not change roundFare globally or Dublin.

otsReferenceModel.note: Distance/time reference for public A2A quotes. Commercial position vs OTS is applied via addressToAddressDistanceBands (short undercut, long empty-return uplift) — not a flat undercut on every journey. undercutMin/Max here are A2A-oriented fallbacks only; airport-zone calibration uses airportOtsCalibration (£3–£5).

addressToAddressDistanceBands.note: Adjustment applied to the OTS-style reference fare by loaded distance. Negative = short-trip undercut; positive = long-haul empty-return protection. Benchmarks (Belfast centre): Newry ~£81/£93, Derry ~£127/£146, Enniskillen ~£145/£165.

dublinCityBeyondAirport.note: Belfast-area to Dublin city (NOT Dublin Airport) = DUB airport fare for the NI origin + continuation beyond the airport. Never treat Dublin city as DUB.

expressDropOffFeesGbp.note: Optional customer Express Drop-Off/Pick-Up add-on on BFS/BHD airport journeys (once per booking). Not the waived automatic access fee. Keep in sync with shared/express-drop-off.ts.

expressFreePickupConfigured.note: Free pick-up / collection alternative only when true. Free drop-off is always offered for BFS/BHD. Keep in sync with EXPRESS_FREE_PICKUP_CONFIGURED in shared/express-drop-off.ts.
